Only true ones you can support. We avoid words Amazon prohibits, such as medical or health claims and phrases like best seller, and we keep price and shipping out of the title.

desc:
Amazon listing creation that follows the rules gives each new product a complete, correct page from the start. Ecom Swift LLC writes the title, five bullets, description and backend search terms, fills the category attributes and creates the listing in your Seller Central account.

## What goes into a new Amazon listing?

A listing is the product page buyers see, built from structured data rather than free text. It has a title, up to five bullet points, a description, images, a price, a category and attributes such as size, color and material. Hidden backend search terms add words that help Amazon match the product to searches. Every field has its own limits and rules.

If your product already has a catalog page, you match to that page instead of creating a new one. If it is new, you create the page and become the first to define its data.

## Why getting it right the first time matters

Listings that break Amazon's style rules can be suppressed, which means they stop appearing in search. Listings with a vague title or missing attributes are harder for shoppers to find and filter. Fixing these after launch costs time, and the product may lose its first weeks of visibility.

A good first version avoids both. It uses the words shoppers search for, keeps claims within what Amazon allows, and puts attributes in the fields where filters read them.

## How listing quality affects discovery and orders

Amazon search reads titles, bullets, attributes and backend terms to decide which searches a product suits. Shoppers then read the title and first bullets to decide whether to click. If the title is clear, the bullets answer the main questions, and the details are correct, more of the people who find the product will understand it.

Variation families matter for the same reason. When sizes or colors sit under one parent listing, reviews and sales combine on one page, and shoppers choose without leaving. Results still depend on price, images, reviews and competition, and we do not promise rankings.

## What a complete listing includes

- A title within Amazon's style limit that names the product, brand and key feature.
- Five bullets that each lead with one clear benefit.
- A description that adds detail without repeating the bullets.
- Backend search terms that do not repeat the visible text.
- The correct product type, category and attributes.
- Variation families that group sizes and colors correctly.
- A check of claims and prohibited words before saving.
- A plan for image order and slot use.
- A style guide so new items follow the same pattern.

## How we create your listings

We begin with the product data you send: specifications, materials, dimensions, supplier details and any barcode or GTIN information you hold. We search the catalog to see whether a matching page exists, then research the keywords shoppers use for each item.

We write the text, enter it and the attributes in your account, and check each field against Amazon's rules on claims and wording. The Basic, Standard and Premium packages cover a growing number of listings, with variation setup and keyword research in the middle package, and a shared tone, image plan and style guide in the largest. We do not create the images in this service.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Send accurate specifications and sizes for every product.
- Use barcodes that you own or have a right to use.
- Write what the product is before what it does.
- Group true variations under one parent.
- Keep claims specific and verifiable.

**Avoid:**
- Putting prices, shipping offers or contact details in the text.
- Using another brand's name to attract searches.
- Stuffing the title with repeated keywords.
- Describing health benefits that you cannot document.
- Creating a new page for a product that already has one.

## Who this is for

This service suits a seller preparing a first product range who wants every page to be clean. It also suits a wholesale seller adding new items each month who wants a repeatable pattern. A brand with colors and sizes can use it to set up proper variation families.

## What we need from you

Please send product specifications, any existing supplier copy, your barcodes or GTIN details and the category you plan to use. You invite us as a user in your Seller Central account with listing permissions, and we never ask for your password.
